title: Provider validation samples must stay inside the supported security scope and execution time
context: The provider evidence format already required a real authorized call and a bounded sample window, but the validator accepted any nonempty security_code and did not require the sample window to have ended by the recorded execution timestamp. That allowed internally inconsistent or out-of-scope sample attestations to pass structural validation.
decision: sample.security_code must pass the same Invest v1 Shanghai/Shenzhen main-board format gate used by invest.data.is_mainboard_symbol.
sample.end_date must not be later than the calendar date represented by executed_at.
These checks are fail-closed structural evidence checks and do not establish issuer identity, listing status, market-data completeness or strategy effectiveness.
This gate does not contact a provider, use credentials, create real provider evidence, open frozen holdout data or authorize a PR merge.
rationale: A record describing real provider validation must be internally compatible with the project's declared v1 market scope and cannot claim a sample period extending beyond the evidence execution time.
